embeddings.title: Preparing your documents
embeddings.description: Indexing the attached files so they can be searched and cited. This may take a moment for large documents.

creation.configure: Choose a cloud model with its API key, or configure the selected local engine and its required files in Creation settings.
creation.localNote: Local images use a complete Diffusers folder, separate GGUF/Safetensors components with stable-diffusion.cpp, or supported native NVFP4 CUDA weights with Python 3.15.1. Video uses Diffusers. CPU/GPU choices are separate for the encoder and image generator in component-based engines.
creation.autosave: Completed images and videos are saved automatically in separate Novera folders inside your system Pictures and Videos folders, with their generation settings.
creation.autoNote: Auto recognizes explicit image or video creation requests in French and English. You can always select the output format yourself.
creation.source: An existing creation will be used as the input image.
creation.variantPrompt: Create a new version of this image, keeping its main subject.
creation.missing: This creation was moved or is no longer available on this computer.
creation.desktopOnly: Image and video creation with automatic saving is available in the desktop application.
creation.inputUnsupported: Use one image supported by the selected model. Video inputs and multiple input images are not supported here.
creation.animatePrompt: Animate this image while preserving its main subject.
creation.filterNote: Image and Video filter the generated output. Multimodal models can understand several types of input; this does not always mean they can generate images or video.
creation.inputRequired: This model needs an input image.
creation.generationOnly: This model creates media. Select it in the Image or Video category.
creation.cloudNote: Cloud generation sends your prompt and input image to the selected provider and may incur charges. Stopping locally may not cancel remote billing.
creation.cloudDefaults: Cloud uses provider-specific presets. Local parameters apply to the selected local creation engine.
creation.cloudTimeout: The cloud job did not finish within the time limit. Check its status with the provider before starting another paid generation.
creation.adobeCredentials: Adobe Firefly needs an access token and the x-api-key client identifier in the provider settings.
creation.catalogNote: This provider uses a maintained model list. Refreshing it does not validate the key or your account access. No paid generation is used to test credentials.
creation.ggufNote: Choose the diffusion model, text encoder and VAE separately. For FLUX.2 Klein 4B, use a compatible Qwen3-4B encoder, including its GGUF variants. Supported NVFP4 files are prepared once with Python 3.15.1 and PyTorch into a larger compatibility cache; originals stay unchanged. This needs extra disk space and RAM. Keep sd-cli with its libraries. Auto uses available hardware; CUDA needs a CUDA build. Distilled Klein normally uses 4 steps and CFG 1. No weights are downloaded.
creation.ggufWrongModel: This GGUF contains a text encoder. Select it in the encoder field and choose a separate diffusion model in the image field.
creation.nativeNote: Native NVFP4 CUDA: FLUX.2 Klein 4B Comfy weights, Qwen3-4B GGUF encoder and FLUX.2 Safetensors VAE. Requires Blackwell (RTX 50 series or compatible), Python 3.15.1, CUDA PyTorch and the optional NVFP4 dependencies. Text-to-image only. Unsupported hardware fails explicitly; select stable-diffusion.cpp for compatibility. No BF16 diffusion cache.
creation.deviceNote: These components have independent device choices. Auto uses available hardware; native NVFP4 always requires a compatible GPU for generation and uses GPU text encoding when enough VRAM is free. Qwen on CPU can save VRAM but slow encoding. Qwen on GPU uses layer offload. In stable-diffusion.cpp, Auto follows the selected engine; forcing CUDA requires a CUDA build.
creation.totalTimeHint: Total time includes loading, text encoding, generation, any cloud waiting, downloading and saving. Generation alone is shown separately when the engine reports it.
creation.recommendedSetupNote: GPU generation, Qwen3-4B encoding on CPU, 4 steps, CFG 1. Tested on Windows with Vulkan; speed and compatibility depend on your hardware.

creationInstall.confirm: Download these files to this folder? The providers’ licences apply.
creationInstall.background: You can keep chatting and creating images or videos during downloads. Follow progress using the main-bar icon.
creationInstall.engine: Built-in engine: automatic CUDA / Vulkan / CPU
creationInstall.note: GPU generation, Qwen3-4B encoding on CPU, 4 steps, CFG 1. Tested on Windows with Vulkan; speed and compatibility depend on your hardware.
creationInstall.error: Installation failed. Check your network, free space, access rights and model licences, then resume.

memory.title: Local model memory
memory.autoNote: Loads models on demand and releases unused models after active work finishes.
memory.manualNote: Text, image and video can run together in separate conversations if RAM/VRAM permits. Models may run out of memory.
memory.preserve: Files and conversations are kept; models reload when needed. Changes apply to new requests.
memory.failed: Memory optimization failed. Retry or choose Manual.
